methodology.purpose: Adversarially test whether each frozen target can enter blind neutralization without combining distinct native owners or claiming an unsupported seam.
methodology.credit_boundary: GO authorizes only a bounded clean-room requirements packet. NO_GO requires target-facet reconciliation before neutralization. Neither verdict awards a mapping or completion credit.

results.bounded_owner: Clinical observation register and record command
scope_guards: Questionnaire or wizard ownership is excluded.
Approval and escalation lifecycles are excluded.
Foreign-Site direct-object behavior is explicit 403 in current source and must not be restated as concealed 404.
No ordinary request replay contract is established.
results.reason: One canonical service owns the typed record transaction and register surface, so a clean bounded behavior packet can be compared without absorbing another workflow.

results.bounded_owner: Clinical event register and initial record command
scope_guards: Review, follow-up, escalation, and linked incident closure are excluded.
Foreign-Site direct-object behavior is explicit 403 in current source and must not be restated as concealed 404.
Attachments are persisted after the core service transaction, so full package atomicity is not established.
No create replay contract is established.
results.reason: The initial event record and register form a bounded owner even though later event actions and attachments have separate orchestration boundaries.

results.bounded_owner: Not singular at the frozen target level
results.reason: The frozen row combines seven actions across controller, intake, access, identity, audit, and after-commit boundaries; neutralizing it as one operation would hide materially different authority and replay semantics.

scope_guards: Initial submission and reopen are excluded.
Investigation, root cause, improvement actions, H&S governance, and Control Room ownership remain canonical external prerequisites, not duplicated incident states.
Review lacks an approved-Site assertion; close and reopen deny foreign Site as 403 rather than concealed 404.
Repeat review and close reject state rather than return an original result.
results.reason: Review and close are bounded state transitions with explicit locks and prerequisites, provided external governance owners remain excluded and their evidence is treated only as a gate.
Read, movement, balance, discrepancy, destruction, witness, Site, action-capability, locking, and replay semantics are materially inconsistent; one neutral contract would conceal contradictions.

results.bounded_owner: Payment match workflow plus allocation history projection
results.reason: The frozen row combines an append-only history projection with a separate suggested-match lifecycle and settlement side effects; exact authority, state, and replay claims must be reconciled per facet.
